authority_boundary: Screening policy only; final remass quantities require populated Q6 Navigator mission regression.

working_policy_interpretation.normal_dispatch_remass_t: Hypothesis for Q6 scoring, not a replacement for the inherited 250 t governing comparison baseline.
working_policy_interpretation.minimum_dispatch_remass_t: Below this screening value, dispatch is blocked pending explicit waiver/replan.
working_policy_interpretation.protected_optimizer_reserve_t: Normal propulsion remass withheld from routine optimizer consumption; distinct from the 50 t protected life-support/water reserve in CANON II.
working_policy_interpretation.contingency_feed_reserve_t: Zero until Q2/Q5 establish whether a separately carried alternate feed reserve is worthwhile.
working_policy_interpretation.one_tank_isolation_fraction: Four equal major tanks imply a first-order 25% accessible-remass loss if one full tank is isolated; actual state must use measured tank fill distribution.

optimizer_rules: Routine optimizer may use ECON and CRUISE only unless a higher urgency class is explicit.
EXPEDITE requires time-critical authorization and must expose incremental remass/thermal cost.
HARD requires emergency or tactical authorization and must not be selected solely for schedule improvement.
LIMIT is contingency-only and requires explicit duration, thermal, structural and reserve closure.
Protected optimizer reserve is not available to routine route optimization.
Protected life-support/water reserve is never counted as routine propulsion remass.
open_items: Populate Q6 representative mission suite from live Navigator outputs.
Select final normal and minimum dispatch remass from mission distribution rather than screening values.
Define contingency-feed reserve only after alternate-feed certification closes.
Replace equal-tank isolation approximation with actual tank-state accessibility when Navigator exposes it.
Close degraded radiator/reactor/RCS states against Q5/Q4 card limits.
